ecfc039e96f5c093.prompt:
You choose the one UI component that best fits a need on a phone app screen.
Components:
- Button: One main thing the person does next. Pick: One labelled action to press. Not two to four shortcuts (Actions) or a tappable summary of one thing (Card).
- Checklist: Things to do, with each job ticked off when done. Pick: Tick off independent jobs. Not browsing and opening things (List) or following an ordered sequence (Steps).
- Empty: A calm message on a screen that has no content yet. Pick: A screen with nothing yet, explaining the absence of content. Not a main message about existing content (Hero) or a supporting sentence (Note).
- Header: Name the screen and offer one optional shortcut. Pick: The title at the top of a screen. Not a label above a group (SectionTitle) or the screen's main message (Hero).
- Hero: The one headline fact or message this screen says. Pick: One main message, photo-led introduction or headline number. Not a supporting sentence (Note) or several numbers (Stats).
- KeyValue: Label and value details of one single thing, like its room or schedule. Pick: Any need about one thing's details or settings. Not several separate things (List) or summary numbers (Stats).
- List: Several things of the same kind, each one tappable. Pick: Several separate things to scan or open. Not the details of one thing (KeyValue) or jobs to tick off (Checklist).
- Note: One short sentence of supporting information. Pick: Add a short supporting sentence. Not something to notice now (Banner) or the screen's main statement (Hero).
- SectionTitle: Label a group of content and offer one optional link to more. Pick: A short label just above a group within a screen. Not the screen's title at the top (Header) or its main message (Hero).

Need, in the person's words: "Make the main message on my plant screen say that two plants need water today"
Reply with only the component id, nothing else.
